verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a community comment praising SvelteKit's first-party "form actions" alongside its server/client loading structure, which suggests built-in form handling integrated with the framework. Nothing in the pack documents form-building APIs or validation. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of form actions, any form validation module or schema-validation integration, client-side form state/binding helpers, and hands-on corroboration of how forms integrate with the rest of the framework.
